name: DI - Intelligence Worker
description: Scheduled Delivery Intelligence worker that locks pending di_intelligence_jobs, derives DI records from submitted payload plus read-only project/QA context, persists to di_* tables, and updates job status.

parameters.content:
## Delivery Intelligence Worker
Polls di_intelligence_jobs only. It never reads or writes qa_jobs except read-only context lookup, and never modifies QA workflows. Persists extracted DI records through public.di_persist_extraction using the Supabase service-role credential.
